question: What are the eligibility criteria for the AICTE Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFW)?

(c) Students whose parents' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs 8.00 lakhs per annum are eligible [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3]. (d) A valid Income Certificate issued by the State Authorities only will be accepted [Scholarship_AY_2026_27_website_Apr_1_6c85696a82.pdf, p. 2-3].
